Subject: Uptake acceleration checkpoints & add-on commitments

Hi Samir —

Quick weekly checkpoint from our side on the MAP and the add-on timeline we discussed. High-level status: 
- Usage growth: your production usage has trended +18% week-over-week after the recent rollout to the analytics team. Good momentum.
- Add-ons: we have pricing for Advanced Indexing (ADD-IDX) and Priority SLAs ready to share; attaching the short evaluation plan to help the analytics team trial ADD-IDX in a 2-week spike.
- Close timeline: target contract amendment signed by 2027-06-10 to align with invoicing cadence.

Action items we want to confirm in this note:
1) ClearWave to provision 2 additional test seats for analytics team (owner: Samir) — target 2027-05-24.
2) Redwood to provide evaluation plan + test data checklist (owner: Priya) — sending now (attached).
3) Solutions review + cost estimate for ADD-IDX and Priority SLA (owner: Marcus) — due 2027-05-26.
4) Procurement & SOW draft for amendment (owner: Ben) — initial draft by 2027-05-28 so your legal can review.

I’ve attached the evaluation plan we’ll use for the two-week spike and a placeholder SOW draft. If these owners/timelines don’t map to your team, let me know and we’ll adjust.

Would you be open to a 30-minute check-in next Tuesday (5/25) to walk through the evaluation milestones and any procurement questions? Evelyn will join to ensure CS coverage.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Samir — thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion, confirming the agreed owners and dates so everything is clear: 

Agreed items / owners: 
- Trial seats: ClearWave to provision 3 seats for analytics spike (owner: Samir) — complete.
- Evaluation plan: Redwood to run 2-week spike using attached plan (owner: Priya) — window: 2027-05-29 to 2027-06-11.
- Solutions & pricing: Marcus will send the ADD-IDX cost breakout and one-time setup estimate (owner: Marcus) — due 2027-05-31.
- SOW amendment draft: Ben will send the SOW draft to Linda for legal review (owner: Ben) — due 2027-05-28 (sent) with expected legal turnaround ~5 business days.
- Success criteria & CS playbook: Evelyn will provide the 3-step acceptance checklist and runbook for the handoff to production (owner: Evelyn) — due 2027-05-31.

Open questions for your procurement team: 
1) Are you able to sign an amendment to the existing contract (preferred) or would you require a new PO for the add-on?
2) Does ClearWave have a preferred billing contact or special invoicing fields we should include in the SOW?

Next steps: 
- Ben will share the SOW PDF now; please confirm receipt and any redline requests by 2027-06-02 so we can stay on the 6/10 signature target.
- Marcus will follow up with the pricing slide and a short ops note tomorrow.

If anything changes on your side, flag it in this thread and we’ll re-prioritize. Appreciate the speed here — momentum matters.

Best,
